We ask whether motion trajectories form another such modality: as embodied models become more capable, should their sensory representations converge toward the structure of physical motion? items.title: TAO: Tool-Aware Joint Scheduling for LLM-Based Agentic Serving
items.summary: Agentic services alternate between model inference on clustered GPUs and external tools on distributed CPUs. In this scenario, existing systems (1) overlook tool-return readiness in service evaluation, wasting limited resources, and (2) use heuristic strategies to decide admission and placement on GPUs, resulting in suboptimal scheduling decisions. To bridge this gap, we present TAO, a tool-aware joint scheduling framework for LLM-based agentic serving. items.title: OmniShowcase: Omnidirectional Subject-Consistent Video Generation from Multi-View Images
items.summary: Generating videos of a specific subject from a few reference images remains challenging when the camera reveals surfaces that are not visible in the input. Early subject-to-video (S2V) methods condition on a single reference image and must therefore infer the subject's unseen appearance and geometry as the viewpoint changes. To address this limitation, recent methods extend S2V to multiple reference views, providing more information about the subject from different viewpoints. items.title: Efficient Streaming Audio-Visual Target Speaker Extraction for Real-World Acoustic Scenes
items.summary: Streaming audio-visual target speaker extraction (AVTSE) is essential for latency-sensitive applications. However, current causal systems face two coupled gaps. First, standard benchmarks fix the number of speakers at two and ignore the near-/far-field interference, reverberation, and sudden noise of real scenes. Second, high-performance causal architectures are too heavy for edge deployment. Lightweight alternatives try to reclaim capacity by repeatedly invoking a small separator, which offsets the savings. items.title: DTCA: Denoising Token Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning in Diffusion Language Models
items.summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) generate text through iterative denoising, enabling bidirectional context modeling and parallel token refinement. Recent studies have applied reinforcement learning (RL) to DLMs and improved their reasoning performance. However, the iterative denoising process makes credit assignment more challenging, as final outcome rewards provide limited information about how different tokens contribute to the final output. items.title: AdaPRA: Process Reward Agents with Adaptive Rubrics for Data Science
items.summary: Data science agents can automate end-to-end machine learning workflows, yet they remain far from competitive on human leaderboards. Agents make process errors such as insufficient exploration, unsound validation, coding bugs, and poor use of a fixed budget (re-running the same exploratory data analysis and baseline models in every attempt). items.title: Self-Assessment Reinforcement Learning for Search-State Awareness in Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
items.summary: Recent advances in search agents have enabled large language models to tackle complex tasks by retrieving and synthesizing external information. However, existing search agents often lack search-state awareness, i.e., the ability to recognize what information has been obtained and what remains missing, leading to hallucinated reasoning and prematurely terminated search. items.title: Quaternion Approximate Networks for Enhanced Image Classification and Oriented Object Detection
items.summary: This paper introduces Quaternion Approximate Networks (QUAN), a novel deep learning framework that leverages quaternion algebra for rotation equivariant image classification and object detection. Unlike conventional quaternion neural networks attempting to operate entirely in the quaternion domain, QUAN approximates quaternion convolution through Hamilton product decomposition using real-valued operations. items.title: AlphaBet: Reinforcement Learning for LLM Event Forecasting Agents
items.summary: Forecasting an unresolved event requires finding relevant evidence and deciding how strongly it supports each outcome. Yet outcome-based training of Large Language Model (LLM) forecasters often begins with preassembled evidence at a single prediction date, leaving evidence acquisition outside the learning loop. items.summary: Phenomena responsible for emerging technologies originate from novel molecular states at buried interfaces. Yet quantitatively resolving these features is out of reach in most cases. Resonant scattering has demonstrated sensitivity to these local states but is limited due to a lack of accurate interpretive models. items.summary: Bengali, spoken by over 230 million people, remains severely under-resourced in spoken language research. Existing open Bengali ASR corpora are confined to short, read or crowd-sourced speech and lack speaker diarization and long-form audio. We present Lipi-Ghor, a large-scale weakly-supervised Bengali speech corpus comprising 885 hours of audio sourced from 998 YouTube videos across 596 unique channels, spanning 17 diverse domains including audiobooks, drama, religious sermons, news, and regional dialects. items.summary: Learning velocity fields directly in pixel space is difficult and slow. We show that coarse second-order image statistics can ease this task: frozen Wiener estimates improve velocity learning, with gains extending beyond the linear predictions they explicitly provide. items.summary: Outcome RL raises pass@1 but not pass@k at large k (Yue et al., 2025). But every pass@1 is scored under a token budget. Every recipe also trains under one. On physics and math problems at fixed token budgets, we compare the pass@1 of 20 released RL models (1.5B to 32B) with that of the thinking models they started from. items.summary: Financial institutions operating under data-residency constraints are restricted to open-weight models small enough to locally host, which trail frontier systems on multi-step quantitative reasoning. On-policy distillation narrows such gaps by supervising a student on its own rollouts, but traditional OPD requires a strong external teacher, and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) conditions on a full reference solution. items.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: Unified and Efficient Multimodal Representations
items.summary: We present EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model which natively represents text, images, audio, video, and combinations thereof in a unified space. Our approach introduces improvements such as simplified per-layer embeddings and a multi-stage curriculum with modality and objective progression which ensure strong quality across unimodal, cross-modal, and mixed-modal evaluations. items.title: T-DIG: Text-Conditioned Diversity for Image Generation
items.summary: Text-to-image (T2I) platforms typically return several images per prompt so users can explore different visual interpretations and choose one that matches their intent. However, T2I models are usually optimized for single-image quality which comes at a cost of multi-image diversity, limiting this exploration. Diversity is also contextual: one user wants variations in background, while another wants them in artistic style, and the same user may later want variations in clothing. items.summary: While progress in informal mathematics has come largely from scaling the chain-of-thought and agentic reasoning of frontier language models, formal theorem proving has increasingly relied on human-designed workflows around these models, such as planning, decomposition, and orchestrating specialized provers. items.summary: How much of zero-shot benchmark accuracy is captured by word-level alignment between a pre-training corpus and the benchmark target? We study this question through word-level unigram cross-entropy (UCE), a tokenizer-agnostic, model-free measure of lexical alignment between a reference corpus and a target benchmark. items.summary: Multimodal perception forms the foundation of multimodal intelligence. In particular, spatial perception and multimodal long-context understanding are two pivotal tasks that underpin embodied AI and multimodal agents. items.summary: Looped transformers reuse a shared block of layers to increase computational depth without increasing the number of trainable parameters. They are trained with backpropagation through time (BPTT). items.summary: When an LLM group's discussion is compressed into a short memory for a final decision maker, what should the memory keep? Two natural heuristics keep the rarest claims or the claims relevant to the decision criteria. On hidden-profile tasks both look attractive, because how widely a fact is held is confounded with whether it helps. items.summary: Diffusion video models produce striking clips, but they cannot reliably render an exact formula, a correct chart, a rule-consistent game or narration synchronized to on-screen events. items.summary: Novel view synthesis and 3D reconstruction have advanced rapidly with radiance fields and splatting, yet their memory and computational demands limit their use in resource-constrained settings. Human videos provide much broader behavioral and environmental experience, while learning from them faces a fundamental trade-off between scalable data and explicit action grounding. items.summary: Test-time adaptation helps a deployed model respond to changing inputs, but the same intervention can rescue one batch and damage the next. items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in multi-turn agentic workloads that require sustained interaction with complex environments. items.title: 字节辟谣"群演数据喂大模型"：严重失实！
items.summary: 近日，有网络传言称"横店与字节合作，将15万名群演的肖像和声音喂给字节大模型"。字节豆包公关负责人刘星今日通过微博作出回应，表示该传言严重失实。 据介绍，此次引发讨论的项目为横店影视AI服务平台建设项目。刘星表示，该项目的初衷是希望建设一套影视行业的公共数字基础设施，把影视基地实景等资产做成高质量数据集，帮助剧组更高效地选景、筹备和拍摄，同时降低中小影视企业使用AI的门槛，让更多创作者有条件把作品做好。 针对传言中的关键疑问，刘星澄清了三点： 第一，火山引擎在该项目中仅是技术支持方，所有数据资产均归横店或授权方所有。 第二，项目中涉及任何个人的肖像和声音使用，都需要获得本人授权，不存在未经授权采集的情况。 第三，本项目所采集的数据不会用于训练字节大模型。 公开资料显示，横店影视AI服务平台建设项目目前处于中标阶段，将围绕影视行业数据集建设、配套技术平台等业务展开。

items.summary: 事情是这样子的，我妈妈在上一年 11 月的时候晕倒住院，然后身体就一直不行下去了，吃饭也吃不下去（胃有问题），然后每天吃的越来越少，身体越来越瘦，到现在为止已经住院了三次了。 在前几天，救不回来去世了。去世那天早上她在刷牙，就那个动作一直刷着，刷了 10 多分钟，我们就感觉越来越不对劲，叫她也没有很大反应，就是已经不能正常对话了，我就想带她去医院，这个时候她才刚出院 4 天。这期间车都来了，就我跟我爸我姐在旁边尽量跟她交流说要继续送她去医院，但是她就是不想去（有一点轻微反应，比如说摇头），然后我爸就问她是不是要回老家，她点头了。这个时候我跟我姐就意识到了，回去了顶多过两天就是没了。 之前住院的时候她其实都不太想去，除了第一次晕倒住院她没意识以外，都是我们劝她去的；她的状态就是饭也吃不下，点滴打了也不舒服（部分点滴打了肚子胀），有些药吃了也没用，还会疼（就是医生的治疗方案没什么用）；然后晚上又睡不着；走也走不动，上厕所还需要人扶着看着；就是这样子活着还有什么意思；那时候我也不知道要怎么回答。后来就是我们三个讨论完就送她回老家了。 那是那天早上回去的，回到家的时候已经完全没有意识了，做不出任何回应，我们就找了村里的一个行脚医，给她续了一个葡萄糖，挂了一会儿确实醒了，眼睛能动，手能动，就是说不了，然后一直摇晃着手，看着是想要把输液那只手针弄掉，后面摇晃着手输液的那个地方都肿了，我就把针拆…

items.title: 被裁了，今天最后一天。
items.summary: 27 号通知的，29 号离职，谈了是协议离职，只给了 N ，公司蛮好的，所以也不想太撕破脸(别杠，杠就是你对)。 谈一下这几天的感受，也记录一下，以后翻到了可能有不一样的心境。 经常在网上摸鱼刷帖子，所以也看了不少，也心里准备，但是没想到这么快。 反正很突然，给了 2 天交接，其实也没啥要交接的，就当缓冲一下。 这几天做的事情，因为是工作几年，第一次被裁，所以很多没了解，下面是一些感想，就当看个乐子，我记录一下： 1.失业金的领取，看当地政策，我们这边是最低工资*90 ，然后就看具体能领取几个月了，我算了下，我才工作几年，所以最多只能领取 3 个月好像。 2.失业登记会缴纳社保，不会断(好像)。 3.重新优化了简历，慢慢投了，环境确实不好，我来我司，研发部已经裁了一轮了，现在到我了。 4.今天提交了研发离职结算交接，交接完了，有个说不上来的感觉，不知道怎么形容。 5.顺其自然吧，又成长了不少。
